title: Audit log integrity proofs and residency orchestrator
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Goal: implement an automated pipeline that produces cryptographic integrity proofs for admin audit logs, enforces data residency and retention rules, and exports tamper-evident evidence bundles for legal/escrow requests. Scope covers admin actions, access events, and configuration changes emitted by Redwood Console and Private control planes.

Scope details: generate compact per-day Merkle roots and an append-only journal of signed checkpoints; persist checkpoints in an access-controlled write-once evidence storage layer; attach region residency metadata and retention TTLs per-customer; expose an API for on-demand evidence export and legal-hold manifests. Integrate with KMS for signing and with the compliance dashboard for proofs/verification.

Non-goals: full rework of existing logging ingestion pipeline (we will consume existing audit stream), long-term archival UI work (separate ticket), and cross-cloud legal-entity policy decisioning (legal will define policies and be consulted).

Design constraints: must support per-customer residency tags (US/EU/APAC), must not materially increase ingest latency (>5ms budget), signing keys must be isolated per-tenant group, and evidence bundles must be verifiable by third parties without Redwood internal secrets.

High-level approach: 1) Build a lightweight checkpoint generator service that consumes audit stream, groups events into fixed windows (daily and hourly), computes Merkle roots, and emits a signed checkpoint. 2) Orchestrator applies residency & retention policy, writes the checkpoint and event bundle to a write-once bucket with object lock + immutability TTL. 3) Periodic notarization job publishes compact proof metadata to a customer-facing endpoint and archives a copy to an off-platform escrow when legal-hold/retention policies require. 4) Provide verification tooling (CLI + endpoint) that verifies signatures and inclusion proofs against checkpoints.

Deliverables: prototype checkpoint service, write-once storage integration, residency policy engine, evidence-export API, verification CLI, test harness for tamper attempts, documentation for legal and SOC reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: Signed checkpoints emitted for 99.9% of daily windows with <1% failure rate
Checkpoint compute adds <5ms median latency to audit ingest pipeline
Evidence bundles persisted with object-lock immutability and customer residency tags
Automated export endpoint produces chain-of-custody manifest and downloadable evidence bundle within 15 minutes
Verification CLI can validate Merkle inclusion and signature with public metadata
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal pilot with Redwood core admin logs in a single region (US) for 2 weeks. Phase 2: add EU residency tagging and on-demand export tests with Compliance team. Phase 3: enable multi-region notarization and customer opt-in for escrow exports. Each phase gated by perf/regression benchmarks and security signoff.
risks_and_mitigations: Key compromise risk: mitigation - per-tenant signing keys stored in KMS with regular rotation and key access audits
Storage cost growth: mitigation - retention engine enforces lifecycle transitions and compressed bundle format, cost estimates to SRE
Legal/regulatory variance across regions: mitigation - require Legal review on residency mapping and add region-specific retention overrides
Verification complexity for customers: mitigation - provide a simple CLI and signed metadata endpoint with example verification scripts
